name: BrownianTreeNoiseSampler / BatchedBrownianTree
plain: The per-step noise used by DPM++ SDE family. A Brownian tree gives noise consistent across different step counts because each interval's noise depends on the interval, not the call count. Makes SDE results converge as steps rise.
math:
W(t) via torchsde.BrownianTree(t0, w0=0, t1, entropy=seed), with one tree per seed if a seed list is given.
noise(σ,σ_next) = sign · (W(t1) − W(t0)) / √|t1−t0|, where t = transform(σ) (identity by default).
Division by √|Δt| makes each sample unit variance.

props.distribution: standard normal, correlated across overlapping sigma intervals
props.spectrum: white in space; Brownian in sigma

label: from code
surprise: The tree is on CPU for plain dpmpp_sde and 2m/3m SDE (cpu=True) and on the device for the _gpu variants (cpu=False), so the two give different noise for one seed.
